title: Design System: Polaris Notices and Shared Effects

headline.purpose: Notice admin heading; incumbent serif pairing.

body.purpose: Full message with generous line height.

motion.name: glass-transition
motion.purpose: CTA lift; removed in reduced motion.

motion.name: glass-border-beam
motion.purpose: Conic highlight rotation; stopped in reduced motion.

motion.name: busy-spinner
motion.purpose: Button pending indicator; stopped in reduced motion.

motion.name: paper-frame
motion.purpose: Paper renderer readiness; removed in reduced motion.

motion.name: activity-delay
motion.purpose: Delay before foreground API activity becomes visible.

extensions.scope: components/notices, GlassButton, PolarisLoading, LoadingActivity, effects.module.css, assets/notice-paper-art.js; inherited theme and fonts are referenced, not redesigned.
extensions.rampProvenance: Brown samples the existing polaris Tailwind scale. Other ramps are synthesized display-only OKLCH lightness samples, not implementation tokens. Theme ramp previews use the light-theme source values; actual components inherit live CSS variables.
extensions.rendererBoundary: WebGL paper and orb are documented in DESIGN.md and are not replaced by approximate sidecar geometry. Static UI specimens omit application event handlers.

components.name: Glass button small
components.description: Native brown glass CTA, sm variant. Busy behavior remains in the React component.
components.css: .ds-glass { position:relative; isolation:isolate; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; overflow:hidden; border:0; border-radius:12px; color:#fff4e6; background:#8b5e3c; box-shadow:0 5px 15px -8px rgba(44,24,16,.65); font-family:var(--font-inter),sans-serif; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s; } .ds-glass:hover:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(139,94,60,.55); } .ds-glass:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-glass:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-glass:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c47d4e; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-beam { position:absolute; inset:-200%; background:conic-gradient(from 225deg,transparent 0,rgba(244,215,188,.9) 90deg,transparent 90deg); animation:ds-beam-turn 4s linear infinite; pointer-events:none; } .ds-inset { position:absolute; inset:1px; border-radius:11px; background:linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(84,51,32,.96),rgba(37,25,18,.97)); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); pointer-events:none; } .ds-button-content { position:relative; z-index:1; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-width:0; width:100%; white-space:nowrap; } @keyframes ds-beam-turn { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-beam { animation:none; } .ds-glass { transition:none; } } .ds-glass { min-height:32px; padding:6px 12px; font-size:12px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a scoped record of the implemented notices and shared effects, not a replacement identity for Polaris. The notice paper carries the supplied Site of the Year material and motion in brown and copper. Administrative controls retain the incumbent light and dark workspace themes.

Brown glass buttons provide tactile emphasis. A large transparent Polaris orb supplies graphic-only loading feedback, with status text available to assistive technology. Preserve the Polaris name and compass mark.
keyCharacteristics: Dark floating paper with copper artwork and warm readable text.
Theme-aware administrative surfaces with serif headings and compact sans-serif controls.
Brown glass CTAs with restrained lift and a moving border highlight.
Transparent graphic-only loading connected to pending work.

rules.name: The Theme Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep admin controls bound to the incumbent theme; preserve the notice paper's dark material in either theme.

rules.name: The Floating Reader Rule
rules.body: Open notices over the current page as standalone paper; do not add a user-facing notice workspace or card shell around this reader.

rules.name: The Transparent Activity Rule
rules.body: Present the global loading orb without a visible label, card, or backdrop; retain its accessible status.

dos: Do retain the incumbent light and dark themes around the dark notice paper.
Do use the shared brown glass button for the implemented primary CTA treatment.
Do preserve keyboard access, readable fallback content, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do connect loading feedback to real pending work and keep its status accessible.
donts: Don't wrap the floating reader in a new notice workspace or card shell.
Don't give the global orb a visible text label, opaque background, or loading card.
Don't promote paper texture coordinates or decorative metadata into a whole-app type system.
Don't edit generated effect assets directly.
